[[Image:TheMessenger.png|right|160px]]
'''The Messenger''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion, and was updated in the [[The Curse of the Dark Pharaoh (Revised Edition)|revised edition]]. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Unvisited Isle]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Combat]]
*+2 [[Horror check|Horror]]

Discard The Messenger to avoid being [[devour]]ed.
